items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Topics 10:1
items.html: When ZON are in the phase of back to back, they have only the wall of HGT, which is the phase of the posterior of Ima, as above in Answer 96. Both of them use this posterior together: half of it for ZA, and half of it for Nukva. But the posterior of NHY is lacking to both of them, being in the secret of “and their backs were toward the house.” For the posterior of NHY are from the phase of the Yesod of Aba, which is not revealed except through new Hassadim and Gevurot that come with the illumination of Hochma. Therefore, when Hesed and Gevura come from the face-to-face coupling of Aba and Ima, then the posterior of NHY are also completed for both of them, and ZA takes the Hassadim for himself, and gives the Gevurot to the Nukva. See above, Answer 45. (p. 507, Item 29, and in Inner Light, Sub Header, “Hassadim”)
